overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation where the committee moved a topic noticed for executive session into open session after counsel advised against the executive session basis, without updating the notice.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee deliberated in open session on a topic that had been noticed for executive session.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find no violation of the Open Meeting Law as the Committee decided to discuss a topic in an open session which was noticed as an executive session.
